scientific_integrity: The results are proved for an idealized fixed-mobile-time two-exponential storage model with independent zero-mean Gaussian timing error of unknown positive variance. Exact cumulants, not finite samples, are assumed known. Structural identification is not finite-sample accuracy or independent certification. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: No hydrodynamic dispersion, exchange heterogeneity within zones, nonexponential residence time, or loss of tracer mass
Exactly two distinct, positive storage return rates and two positive capture intensities
Only independent zero-mean Gaussian timing error; unknown offset and arbitrary error distributions are excluded
Finite-sample sixth cumulants can be unstable and truncated tails can cause bias
A broader truncated-moment theorem may imply the specialization; literature search is not proof of originality
title: Sharp five-cumulant bounds and sixth-cumulant identification for two-zone tracer timing
